workflow.title: Before purging Mac build artifacts: review rebuild cost, age and removal method
workflow.primaryIntent: Decide which developer build artifacts to remove without confusing dependency downloads, generated output and project state.
workflow.description: Use Mole's distinct CLI purge and native Clean workflows to plan artifact removal, checking rebuild cost and permanent deletion versus Trash. This is documented workflow analysis, not a cleanup test.
outline: Top official Mole Clean visual after lead, only once rights clear
Separate package caches, generated output, downloaded dependencies and original project state
Read CLI purge selection/age and permanent-deletion boundaries; do not execute examples
Contrast native review-only candidates and flag Preview-specific additions
Check backup, active work, reproducibility, bandwidth and removal destination before approval
Later current-source Breathing Room Space preview, labeled example data
Choose a terminal workflow or an inspection/care preview with disclosed runtime, hosted AI and signing caveats
workflow.interactionPass: Hand off a static decision checklist: generated vs original; lockfile and sources available; active project; offline rebuild possible; Trash vs permanent. It must not imply a browser tool scanned files.
workflow.length: Earned; roughly 900–1500 words, no padding or invented FAQ
workflow.retryScope: If CLI image rights clear, narrow to documented CLI purge artifact review; keep native Clean only as a distinctly labeled paid edition/context note, not a capability demonstrated by CLI visual. Existing draft gate remains blocked.

mole: Free inspectable CLI for terminal-oriented users; GPL does not extend to the native app.
Native app offers app update/uninstall, disk analysis and system monitoring; pricing is one-time for two Macs rather than a subscription.
Mole already documents helper grouping and Preview growth comparison; do not invent a feature gap.
Deletion modes vary: default cache removal and CLI purge can be permanent; review is not guaranteed reversibility.
breathingRoom: May fit owners who want source-implemented ownership/category views, local history and exact-approval daily care; binary parity remains unverified.
Free local core with optional paid authenticated hosted AI, not entirely offline assistance.
Preview lacks Developer ID signing/notarization and clean-machine/physical-Intel validation; Python 3.10+ prerequisite matters.
No benchmark evidence establishes safer/faster cleanup or higher space recovery than Mole.

retryInvestigation.scope: Reuse existing packet and investigate CLI visual rights or genuine non-mutating capture, not repeat native asset request.
retryInvestigation.officialAssetRoute: Pinned README links big-mole.png; tree has GPL LICENSE but no image-specific licence/permission file identified. Root GPL and image co-location alone are not treated as clearance. No image bytes fetched.
retryInvestigation.captureRoute: command -v mo and command -v mole returned no path (shell exit 1). Entrypoint and startup sources read only. Before --help dispatch, common.sh invokes prepare_mole_tmpdir and entrypoint installs cleanup_temp_files trap. base.sh can probe/write temporary roots and prune old files in its dedicated cache/temp root. A complete non-mutating execution path has not been established; no install, command execution, fabricated terminal rendering or extracted-help substitute used.
retryInvestigation.captureLimitations: This is a source-level rejection of an unaudited live capture, not proof a specially reviewed isolated run is impossible. Remaining transitive modules, environment, approved execution surface and capture-output rights need review; do not bypass init or stub output and label it genuine UI.
retryInvestigation.decision: Retain critical image gate. CLI-only framing remains an option only after permitted actual CLI image/capture and inspection; do not use a CLI image as evidence of paid native capabilities.
neededEvidenceOrDecision: Published image-specific licence or retained owner permission covering docs/img/big-mole.png at 84dc779dc651ff1f0509a2054b6e25b8fb5d2ac5, including reproduction scope and attribution/redistribution conditions; then permitted download, SHA-256, decode, privacy and visual review.

Alternatively, an independently audited, explicitly authorized no-install/no-cleanup capture path for genuine CLI UI, plus an established reuse basis for captured output; retain exact version/OS/procedure/raw capture and inspect actual image. No authorization to change safety constraints is presumed.
Native Clean image remains link-only unless permission specifically covers https://mole.fit/img/en/clean.jpg. No outreach authorized.
